workflow: ImageGen component library -> chroma alpha -> modular course adapter -> taste approval -> MM

generation.prompt: Create exactly sixteen separate split-timber roofing shingle sprites in a clean 4-column by 4-row component sheet, matching the supplied warm timber-shingle roof references. Every shingle is upright: squared hidden attachment edge at the top and hand-split, softly rounded or modestly irregular exposed edge at the bottom. No rotation, flipping, perspective, or upside-down pieces. Use a flat #00ff00 chroma background. Keep a coherent maintained warm oak/cedar family with narrow variation across honey brown, muted chestnut, and warm ochre-brown. Use broad quiet wood planes, restrained vertical split grain, sparse knots, and slight handmade silhouette differences. Exactly sixteen isolated components; no shadows, AO, bevel lighting, labels, text, nails as focal points, roof field, moss, rot, damage, or extra objects.
